Bins of a spectrum: one tone, and where it leaks

Slide a tone across the bins of a DFT. On a bin it is one clean bar; between bins it leaks everywhere, unless a window tapers the seam.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • gHashTag/t27 specs/fpga/dsp/signals.t27 (t27#8985): every value on the page is its fn bodies, compiled to wasm (logic.js)
  • F. J. Harris, On the use of windows for harmonic analysis with the discrete Fourier transform, Proc. IEEE 66(1), 1978
  • R. G. Lyons, Understanding Digital Signal Processing, 3rd ed., ch. 3: the DFT, leakage and windows
